episode_summary: This episode explores the power of YouTube as a lead generation tool for real estate agents, particularly in smaller markets. Gina DiAngelo shares insights on overcoming the fear of video, starting with low-cost production, and the unique advantages of YouTube leads. The discussion emphasizes the importance of consistency and the potential for building a personal brand through video content.
